decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's established web-mapping knowledge and its active early release cycle suggests the firm can learn from feedback and improve it rather than withdraw it.
The plugin is close to the core geospatial offer and therefore fits the firm's absorptive capacity, though its lower prominence makes it slightly more vulnerable than the most central products.
A mobile map-control component is strongly related to the firm's existing GIS and application capabilities, so the firm is likely to retain and refine it for growing mobile use cases.
As a flagship GIS platform line close to the firm's core business, it matches existing knowledge exceptionally well and is highly likely to remain on the market.
Mobile field data capture is adjacent to the firm's established enterprise geospatial solutions and should benefit from its in-house R&D, sector knowledge, and customer integration capabilities.

This search extension is well within the firm's existing web-map expertise and complements its solution portfolio, although as an add-on product it is somewhat easier to discontinue than the main platform offerings.
